defect_1.name: Separate historical D3 seven-rule treatment semantics from D3.5 focused two-rule treatment semantics
defect_1.details: D3Arm and D3ExperimentConfig manage historical D3 with 7 rules (lmd_fit_data_chain, event_poca_handoff, pid_two_pass_files, model_factory_theory, effective_acceptance_pipeline, restgas_profile_workflow, root_macro_usage). D3_5Arm and D3_5ExperimentConfig manage D3.5 with 2 focused rules (event_poca_handoff, restgas_profile_workflow). The other 5 historical rules remain active background rules across all four D3.5 arms.

defect_2.name: Restore exact historical / STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED structured-path behavior
defect_2.details: derive_unbridged_structured_seeds preserves pre-A1 semantics (no 8-seed cap, admits all unique G/S/D seeds, admits all Tier-D ambiguity candidates, no atomic budget constraint). D3.5 bridge independently uses derive_d3_5_bridge_seeds (cap 8, atomic ambiguity constraint).

defect_3.name: Make STRUCTURED_BRIDGED genuinely additive
defect_3.details: STRUCTURED_BRIDGED composes bridged candidates onto the unbridged graph baseline (unbridged_graph = merge_exact_streams(candidates, ordinary_graph)). When bridge produces 0 candidates, STRUCTURED_BRIDGED graph channel exactly equals STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED. Prefix displacement is measured relative to unbridged_graph.

defect_4.name: Require governed source qualification for evidence_paths
defect_4.details: evidence_paths requires explicit governed evidence_source_ids matching plan/context scope; missing evidence_source_ids fails closed with GOVERNED_PROVENANCE_INVALID and reason 'evidence path lacks explicit governed source qualification'. evidence_object_ids does not require evidence_source_ids.

isolation_and_materialization_status.implemented_isolation_mechanism: StorageSettings(database_url=...) configurable via PANDA_DATABASE_URL, in-memory T0 mock graph reader boundaries
isolation_and_materialization_status.provisioning_note: A configured isolation mechanism exists, but the persistent target database was not provisioned because permission was not granted by safety approval. Production database was untouched.

implementation_components.responsibility: Separate D3 / D3.5 arm configs, derive_unbridged_structured_seeds (unbounded) vs derive_d3_5_bridge_seeds (cap 8, atomic ambiguity), Mechanism A phased typed traversal, Mechanism B terminal exact materialization with mandatory evidence_source_ids for paths, reachability and bridge receipts, additive baseline composition, and displacement diagnostics.

Integration of D3.5 bridge into retrieval pipeline, additive graph channel composition (bridged_candidates + unbridged_graph), displacement diagnostics relative to unbridged baseline, and full trace diagnostic propagation.

Dedicated T0 unit and synthetic tests covering four arms, 2-rule D3.5 suppression vs 54 background rules, atomic ambiguity, unbounded unbridged baseline vs capped bridge, Mechanism A traversal & budget, Mechanism B exact materialization & source qualification, receipts, additive graph prefix displacement diagnostics, and zero-bridge equivalence.
Regression tests ensuring backward compatibility across all historical D3 experimental arms with 7 frozen rules.

candidate_integration_and_diagnostics.zero_bridge_equivalence: exact match between STRUCTURED_BRIDGED and STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED when bridged_candidates is empty

tests.anti_leak_audit: PASS: no formal case/question/expected-evidence metadata and no new case-specific mapping occur in runtime bridge logic. Pre-existing frozen D3/D3.5 selected rule IDs remain only in nonsemantic arm suppression/configuration; Mechanism A/B have zero semantic dependency on them and selected_legacy_payload_reuse_count remains 0.

known_limitations: No synchronized persistent isolated evaluation database was provisioned in this environment (safety approval was not granted); persistent evaluation materialization remains unverified outside T0 in-memory/static fixtures.
Mechanism C governance disposition remains pending for D3.5-A1-R2.
D3.5-A1-R1 is a prototype implementation repair verified with synthetic T0 tests; no formal retrieval-quality benchmarking or outcome exposure has been executed.
